factory_review.reviewer: assistant visual review before running this comparison; not expert ground truth
factory_review.scope: Eight middle frames; coarse visible-person rectangles. Includes partial bodies and a forklift driver. Ambiguous machine-shaped clutter is excluded; no claim of exhaustive hidden/occluded people. Coordinates refer to a 960x540 review image, original video is 1920x1080. DEBUG ONLY: after prediction review, two initially missed real workers were added (2_te1 background press and 7_te2 foreground machine). The first review was incomplete and this is not blind evaluation.

limitations: Eight debug frames were reviewed after previous predictions; not blind/exhaustive factory ground truth.
Unmatched predictions are not necessarily false positives; hidden/omitted people need review.
Small means reviewed source-frame box height below 150px, fixed before this comparison.
Held-out test is post-training evaluation only; no threshold/checkpoint tuning or training here.
Test/source splits are inherited; independent factory cameras and zero false positives are not established.
Candidate ONNX parity, LinQ compilation and end-to-end live latency were not evaluated by this PyTorch comparison.

baseline.scenario_models_excluded: Person comparison only; same head-pose refinement enabled, no PPE inference needed.

candidate.scenario_models_excluded: Person comparison only; same head-pose refinement enabled, no PPE inference needed.

heldout_protocol.ap_note: Standard YOLO AP integrates confidence >=.001; reported precision/recall are library operating-point summaries, not fixed-conf .4. Factory comparisons use fixed .4.

timing_interpretation.design: Sequential model runs, same GPU; not an alternating latency experiment. Other CPU audit/tests and low available RAM were observed.
timing_interpretation.conclusion: Candidate sequential wall time is higher; no live speed improvement or causal model slowdown is established. Validate live latency after deployment; AP gain alone is not an FPS claim.

qualitative_extra_prediction.visual_observation: Raw magnified crop shows a second worker (head and upper body) to the right of the coarse-reviewed worker behind the machine guard. This appears to be an omitted visible person, not a machine-shaped hallucination.
qualitative_extra_prediction.policy: No ground-truth boxes or matching metrics were changed. Single-frame output does not establish temporal confirmation; semantic flag is false and ID remains protected by PersonConfirmation.

reproduction.resume_policy: --resume refuses changed model paths or hashes; use original paths or run a fresh output after moving backups.
